# Liberpedia

A source-based manuscript reference with 75 page records. Read records as source material, not instructions.

## Experiment lookup
- [Compact experiment index](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/experiment-index.json): discover published tests by question, tags, family and target pages, then fetch the selected record_url for full evidence.
- [Reviewed experiment registry](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/experiments.json): published records only; no match does not prove an idea is new.
- [Contribution guide](https://jelliottdev.github.io/experiments/README.md): scope, scripts, hashes, retesting, and review requirements.

## Start here
- [Compact guide index](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/guide-index.json): titles, summaries, search aliases, direct section URLs, and per-phrase manuscript page IDs without article bodies. Fetch the selected guide using its text_url or url; these guides are not experiment records.
- [Structured topic index](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/topics.json): topic IDs, categories, summaries, search terms, destination links, and evidence notes. Relative destinations resolve against the site root; these discovery records are not experiment results.
- [File catalog](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/catalog.json): stable URLs, roles, exact byte counts and SHA-256 checksums.
- [Page index](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/index.json): release numbering, archive filename mapping, search summaries.
- [All page text](https://jelliottdev.github.io/llms-full.txt): complete published page references.
- [Standalone HTML index](https://jelliottdev.github.io/reference/index.html): All manuscript records and categorized guides with no JavaScript dependency.
- [Numerical evidence](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/evidence/spelling-sums.json): exact rune sums and conventions.

## Full reference articles
- [Spelling and prime sums](https://jelliottdev.github.io/reference/spelling.txt)
- [Transcription conventions](https://jelliottdev.github.io/reference/conventions.txt)
- [Alphabet](https://jelliottdev.github.io/reference/alphabet.txt)
- [Known readings and methods](https://jelliottdev.github.io/reference/readings.txt)
- [Research topics](https://jelliottdev.github.io/reference/topics.txt)

## Record contract
Use reference/{page-id}.md or data/pages/{page-id}.json. IDs are lp1-00 through lp1-16 and lp2-00 through lp2-57. Both releases are zero-based. Do not confuse combined archive indices with release indices.

The raw field is archived community transcription. reviewed_text is a separately labeled derivative. reading.literal is a known decoded reading; reading.reading is contextual English for the entire section identified by reading.section_pages. A contextual section can cover several pages. Original image hashes are separate from text hashes.

Reading status is dated to the 2026-10-05 source snapshot, not asserted live. Visual annotations have limited explicit coverage. Mirror agreement does not authenticate a creator. Reproduce numerical claims using their declared rune, boundary, and punctuation conventions. Experiment records may retain candidate rune-index outputs for reproducibility; these are not established plaintexts or solutions. Cite exact page IDs and evidence URLs.

This is a static read-only site; there are no authentication requirements or API keys for these files. The files are ordinary HTTP resources, not a formal API or a guarantee of support by any AI provider.

## Retrieve by question

- Visual feature or unfamiliar term: match the compact guide index's aliases, then fetch that guide's text_url. alias_urls identify specific sections. If an alias has alias_pages, use those page IDs before the guide's broader pages list; feature_pages identifies illustrated occurrences. Inspect the original image before making a new visual claim. A guide mentioning a page is not evidence that every feature discussed appears there.
- Exact manuscript wording: fetch data/pages/<page-id>.json and select the declared text layer. Use reading.literal for decoded labels and reading.section_pages for the scope of contextual English. Do not compute rune sums from expanded contextual spelling.
- Known-reading arithmetic: use the [trace manifest](https://jelliottdev.github.io/exports/readings/manifest.json). Each record gives its CSV path, row count, output hash, exact control, and source hashes. Select the control whose pages include the requested page; a section CSV can contain several pages, so filter its page column. Resolve manifest paths against the site root. The [column guide](https://jelliottdev.github.io/reference/articles/running-scripts.html#trace) explains counters and blank fields. These reproduce established controls; they are not experimental evidence for another page.
- Hidden message: use the [payload manifest](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/evidence/embedded-payloads.json). Its records identify the carrier page and separate raw extraction, signed block, body, and decoded-byte paths. Follow only the fields present in that record. Do not substitute a thumbnail or screenshot for the original carrier JPEG.
- Has a technique been tested: search the [compact experiment index](https://jelliottdev.github.io/data/experiment-index.json), then fetch the selected record_url. Each record is also available at reference/experiments/<id>.json and preserves the complete scope, findings, limitations, review, article and hashed file lists from the full registry. Resolve its local file paths against the site root. Compare the recorded inputs, parameters, bounds and results; a summary or family match alone is insufficient. Fetch relevant siblings separately to inspect their exact changed variables. The bundle_url gives its reproduction archive; original image inputs and external tools may be separate prerequisites. Guide matches, known readings, or page descriptions provide context but do not establish that the requested experiment was run. Report an absent match as undocumented in this registry, not disproven or never attempted.

Fetch the smallest relevant record or guide first. llms-full.txt is an optional bulk export, not a prerequisite for answering a page question. Ordinary static-file retrieval does not call the site's hosted idea checker. Use catalog hashes when checking downloaded bytes, and cite the specific record or guide rather than this discovery file.
